description:
Golden Basket is a recipe book and buying guide for people in India who cook with an air fryer. Every recipe is original, written for hot air instead of the pan, and ends with a real temperature and time so you never have to guess.

WHAT YOU GET

Air fryer recipes made for Indian kitchens

1,100+ original recipes: paneer tikka, samosa, aloo tikki, tandoori gobi, seekh kebab, chicken 65, fish fry, momos, pakora, cutlets, fries and much more. Plain, simple steps and tips you can use right away.

Veg, egg or non-veg in one tap

Filter the whole book by what you eat. Pick veg, egg or non-veg and see only those recipes.

Exact temperature and time on every recipe

Each recipe ends with the air fryer temperature and the cooking time. Recipes with meat, fish or egg also give a doneness cue, so you know when it is cooked through.

Cook Mode with a live timer

Go through the recipe step by step, from prep to plate. Steps can be read aloud while your hands are busy, and a live countdown runs at the right temperature, with an alert when the time is up.

What can I make?

Tap the ingredients you already have at home and see which recipes you can cook tonight.

In a hurry

Filter to dishes you can finish in 10, 15, 20 or 30 minutes, prep included.

Guides for every cook

Your first cook, oven to air fryer conversions, a temperature cheat sheet for Indian food, troubleshooting, and cleaning and care.

Nutrition per serving

See macros per serving and an A to E Balance Grade on every recipe. These are estimates to help you compare dishes. They are not diet advice.

Every recipe in Hindi

Switch the language and read all the recipes in simple Hindi. More Indian languages are planned.

Works offline

The recipe book is on your phone, so you can cook even when the signal is weak.

THE BUYING GUIDE

Thinking of buying an air fryer, or upgrading? The buying guide covers 214 air fryer models sold in India, scored on fit for your kitchen, owner ratings and value. The ranking is commission-blind: what a seller may pay us never changes the order.

GOOD TO COOK

Tikka and kebabs for a weekend. Samosa and pakora when it rains. Quick snacks for the kids. A spoon of oil does the job that a pan of oil does in deep frying. Start with a simple recipe and build from there.

Golden Basket is for new air fryer owners and for people who have used one for years. Open it, pick a dish, and cook.

Questions or recipe requests? Write to us from the Account screen in the app.

Nutrition values and grades are estimates for general information and are not medical or dietary advice.

Take a photo of your plate and Blubo finds the foods and works out the calories, protein, carbs and fat. You can fix any amount in a tap, so the numbers stay yours.

Scan a packaged food to see its nutrition. Scan an ingredient label and Blubo explains each ingredient in plain words.

Your streak counts the days you log food. Missing a calorie target never breaks it. Build a streak, watch the calendar fill up and earn milestones from 3 days to a full year.

Colourful charts for your weekly calories and macros, your weight trend and your streak. Compare today with yesterday and this week with last week.

Log water in one tap, in ml or oz. Log your weight once a day in kg or lb. Blubo only celebrates that you tracked, never that the number went up or down.

Your logs stay on your phone. You can delete a single meal, or delete all your data at any time from Profile.

description:
Make bacon, pancetta, biltong, jerky and salami at home — without guessing the salt.

SaltCure is a meat curing calculator and batch tracker in one: it works out your cure to the gram, tracks every batch from day one to ready, and walks a first-timer through their first bacon without special gear.

THE CURE CALCULATOR

• A dry cure calculator and a wet cure calculator in one — salt as a rub, or salt as a brine.

• Equilibrium curing: salt, sugar and cure worked out as a percentage of the exact weight of your meat, instead of a fixed recipe you have to rescale in your head.

• A curing salt calculator that knows your packet is not the same as everyone else's.

• Grams or ounces, °C or °F, millilitres or fluid ounces.

YOUR PACKET, NOT AN ASSUMPTION

• Cure #1 (pink curing salt), Cure #2, peklosol, Nitritpokelsalz (NPS), or your own nitrite %.

• Nitrite content differs about tenfold between these standards. Using an American number with a European packet is the one mistake that actually matters — and most calculators never ask which one you bought.

• Every dose is checked against USDA/FSIS limits, with the ppm shown and the correction spelled out when a dose runs over.

PRESETS FOR WHAT YOU ACTUALLY CURE

• Bacon — a bacon cure calculator for belly, dry or brined.

• Canadian bacon — the loin, with its own numbers.

• Jerky — a jerky cure calculator for strips.

• Biltong — a biltong salt calculator, with the drying loss to match.

• Pancetta and salami — longer, slower, and tracked to the weight they should lose.

• Custom — coppa, bresaola, snack sticks, or whatever else is hanging in the fridge.

A BATCH TRACKER THAT REMEMBERS

• Log every batch with its weight, recipe and start date, and read the day count without doing sums on the calendar.

• A daily reminder so you never miss a flip, and a separate one for the day it is done.

• Weight-loss tracking: the % lost against the target band for that dish. Stop cutting into pancetta a week early, and judge biltong drying time by weight instead of by guesswork.

• Photos, notes and a rating — repeat the batch that came out perfect, and see what went wrong on the one that didn't.

RECIPES THAT TEACH AS YOU GO

• Bacon — dry cure or brine, finished baked, smoked or fried.

• Canadian bacon — the loin, start to slice.

• Your own cure — the same steps, your dish.

• Plain English at every step, with the reasoning where it counts: why curing salt matters, how much of it, and what to never do. No forum-hopping, no two recipes contradicting each other.

HOW MUCH SALT DOES CURING ACTUALLY TAKE?

Equilibrium curing means picking a percentage instead of burying the meat in salt and hoping. Somewhere around 2–3% salt by the weight of the meat is the usual working range, sugar goes in to balance it, and the curing salt is dosed so the nitrite lands inside the limit for that kind of product — a limit that is not the same for bacon, for jerky and for something hung up for six weeks. None of this arithmetic is hard. It is just easy to get wrong at 11pm with a wet pork belly on the counter, and the mistake costs you the meat. That is the part SaltCure does for you.

WHY SALTCURE

• Offline-first — your batches live on your phone. No account, no sign-up, no cloud.

• No equipment required: kitchen scales and a fridge are enough to start home charcuterie.

• Built by home curers, for home curers.

• English and Ukrainian.

Salt-cured meat is one of the oldest crafts there is. SaltCure just makes sure you get the numbers right.

Note: SaltCure follows published USDA/FSIS guidance for home reference. Always follow safe food-handling practice.

description:
Coupe is the premium cocktail recipe app for home bartenders. Whether you're just starting out or building a serious home bar, Coupe gives you everything you need to discover, craft, and master cocktails — beautifully designed and always in your pocket.

THOUSANDS OF RECIPES

Browse the full IBA cocktail catalogue alongside thousands of classic and contemporary recipes from around the world. Search by cocktail name, by spirit, by ingredient, or by what's already sitting on your shelf. Every recipe includes step-by-step instructions, precise measurements in oz or ml, the right glassware, category, and a dynamic ABV estimate. From a perfect Negroni to an obscure Tiki classic, it's all here.

MY BAR

Add the spirits, liqueurs, vermouth, and mixers you own and instantly see every cocktail you can make tonight. Scan bottle barcodes to add new spirits in seconds — Coupe identifies the brand and pre-fills everything for you. The What I Can Make tab updates in real time as your bar grows, so you're never more than a tap away from your next drink.

SHOPPING LIST

Not sure what to buy next? Coupe analyses your current bar and ranks every missing ingredient by how many new recipes it would unlock. See the exact cocktails each new bottle would let you make before you spend a penny. It's the smartest way to grow your bar intentionally, one great bottle at a time.

ABV CALCULATOR

Every recipe shows a dynamic ABV estimate calculated from the actual ingredient volumes and typical spirit strengths — not a generic static number. Tap the ABV card to see a full breakdown showing every ingredient's individual alcohol contribution and what percentage of the total it represents. Know exactly what you're pouring before you pour it.

TASTING NOTES

Coupe is your personal bar journal. Log detailed tasting notes for every bottle you own — brand, actual ABV percentage, country of origin, a personal star rating, and free form notes on flavor, finish, and what cocktails it shines in. Build a record of every spirit you've tried, referenced and searchable any time.

INGREDIENT NOTES

Tap any ingredient in any recipe to add a personal note — your preferred brand for that specific cocktail, a substitution that works better, a technique tip, or anything you've learned from making it. Notes are private by default. Toggle them public to share your knowledge with the Coupe community so other home bartenders can benefit from your experience.

REVIEWS & PHOTOS

Made a great cocktail? Rate it, write a review, and upload photos of your creation. See star ratings, written reviews, and drink photos from the community on every recipe. Discover what people love, how they've adapted classics, and which recipes are community favorites.

BARCODE SCANNER

Scan any bottle's barcode and Coupe instantly searches product databases to identify the spirit — pre-filling the name, brand, and category. Add it to your bar with one tap. Works with hundreds of major brands including Hendricks, Bulleit, Tanqueray, Bacardi, Grey Goose, Patron, Campari, and more.

PDF EXPORT (CRAFT+)

Export your entire bar inventory as a beautifully formatted PDF — complete with tasting notes, personal ratings, ABV, brand, and country of origin for every bottle.

PERFECT FOR

Home bartenders building their first serious bar

Cocktail enthusiasts wanting to explore classic recipes

Hosts who want to impress guests with perfectly crafted drinks

Spirit collectors who love tracking and rating their collection

Anyone who's ever wondered "what can I make with what I have?"

A thoughtful gift for the cocktail lover in your life

DESIGNED FOR HOME BARTENDERS

Coupe is built around the way home bartenders actually work — discovering new recipes, building a bar over time, and wanting to know what you can make right now with what you already have. No bloat, no gimmicks, no subscription required to get real value. Just a beautifully designed app that makes you a better home bartender every time you use it.
